title: Primal Drakkenheim Automation
description: Rules glue for the automated Monsters of Drakkenheim pack: contamination levels, fail-by-5 riders, life drain, regeneration suppression, Frozen breaking on fire or bludgeoning damage, thorns damage, Epic Boss hit points, Epic Actions and initiative 20. Also automates Ignacious, the Sword of Burning Truth: Zone of Truth and firelight while it is drawn in combat. Made with AI: written with Claude (Anthropic).
